plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/; no login required or attempted). Map: 'Logistics Management map for 2026-2027'; program page states 'Catalog 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program page lists TWO pathways for this AS: 'to CSU' (first/default; the map URL names CSU Bakersfield) and 'to Degree' (also printed 60-61.5 units, 4 terms). This plan transcribes ONLY the first/default 'to CSU' pathway; the 'to Degree' pathway is a second general-education pattern for the same credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and Term 1 as 15-16.5 units; the only ranged slot is the Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' choice slot, printed at 3-4.5 units. Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at 3, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum (15 / 15 / 15 / 15) and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. Term 3 prints two identical 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' choice slots; both are recorded, as separate choice slots, exactly as printed. The Term 4 'Area 5C : Laboratory Science' slot prints at 1 unit and the 'CSU Transferable Elective' slot at 2 units, recorded as printed. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites' flag (searched; none present), so no prereqs are recorded. Semester milestone headings printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. Data-quality disclosure: during the 2026-11-15 capture session the mapper served two different versions of its choice-dropdown option data for the same map URLs (an earlier rendering with previous-catalog course numbers/titles, then the current 2026-2027 rendering, confirmed on two consecutive reloads of each map). Degree totals, term totals, major-course rows and slot headings were identical in both renderings; only dropdown option codes/titles differed. Per the Wave100 convention, the option lists behind general-education and elective slots are not enumerated in this seed, so that variation affects no recorded course, code or credit in this plan. The map's printed disclaimer reads: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
